nodes.summary: If `κ_π ≠ 0` and `ρ_g = q₁ q₂ ≠ 0`, then `|E(α₁ α₂³) - 3 ρ_g| ≤ |E(α₁³ α₂) - 3 ρ_g|` iff `q₂² ≤ q₁²`.
nodes.title: The centred moments order `q₁²` and `q₂²`

nodes.summary: If `κ_π < 0` and `ρ_g ≠ 0`, then `|E(α₁ α₂³)| ≤ |E(α₁³ α₂)|` iff `q₁² ≤ q₂²`. So the paper's uncentred criterion needs `κ_π > 0`; the centred criterion `abs_centredMoment_le_iff` does not.
nodes.title: The uncentred comparison is reversed when `κ_π < 0`

nodes.summary: If `κ_π > 0` and `ρ_g ≠ 0`, then `|E(α₁ α₂³)| ≤ |E(α₁³ α₂)|` iff `q₂² ≤ q₁²` (O'Connor and Price 2018, after Equation 2, which states the forward implication).
nodes.title: The paper's uncentred comparison, under its sign condition

nodes.summary: The marginal effect `α₁ = q₁ π + γ₁` on trait 1.
nodes.title: Marginal effect on the first trait in the latent causal variable model

nodes.summary: The marginal effect `α₂ = q₂ π + γ₂` on trait 2.
nodes.title: Marginal effect on the second trait in the latent causal variable model

nodes.summary: The centred mixed fourth moment: `E(α₁³ α₂) - 3 ρ_g = κ_π q₁³ q₂`.
nodes.title: Centred mixed fourth moment $E(\alpha_1^3 \alpha_2)$

nodes.summary: The centred mixed fourth moment: `E(α₁ α₂³) - 3 ρ_g = κ_π q₁ q₂³`.
nodes.title: Centred mixed fourth moment $E(\alpha_1 \alpha_2^3)$

nodes.summary: `gcp ≤ 1` when `q₁² ≤ 1` (for nonzero `q₁, q₂` with `ρ_g² < 1`).
nodes.title: Genetic causality proportion is at most 1

nodes.summary: `gcp ≥ 0` iff `q₂² ≤ q₁²`, for nonzero `q₁, q₂` with `ρ_g² = (q₁ q₂)² < 1`.
nodes.title: Sign of the genetic causality proportion

nodes.summary: The paper's criterion for `gcp ≥ 0` (O'Connor and Price 2018, after Equation 2), under the sign condition `κ_π > 0` that it needs: if `ρ_g ≠ 0`, `ρ_g² < 1` and `|E(α₁ α₂³)| ≤ |E(α₁³ α₂)|`, then `gcp ≥ 0`.
nodes.title: The paper's criterion for `gcp ≥ 0`

nodes.summary: The genetic causality proportion `gcp = (log|q₂| - log|q₁|) / (log|q₂| + log|q₁|)` (O'Connor and Price 2018, Equation 4). Meaningful for `0 < |q₁|, |q₂| ≤ 1` and `ρ_g² < 1`; for `|q₁| = |q₂| = 1` the denominator vanishes and the value is `0` by the convention `x / 0 = 0`.
nodes.title: Genetic causality proportion

nodes.summary: The mirror image of Equation 2: `E(α₁ α₂³) = κ_π q₁ q₂³ + 3 q₁ q₂`.
nodes.title: Mixed fourth moment $E(\alpha_1 \alpha_2^3)$

nodes.summary: The genetic correlation is `E(α₁ α₂) = q₁ q₂` (O'Connor and Price 2018, after Equation 1).
nodes.title: Genetic correlation in the latent causal variable model

nodes.summary: Mixed fourth moment (O'Connor and Price 2018, Equation 2): `E(α₁³ α₂) = κ_π q₁³ q₂ + 3 q₁ q₂`.
nodes.title: Mixed fourth moment

nodes.summary: The excess kurtosis `κ_π = E(π⁴) - 3` of the effect on the latent variable.
nodes.title: Excess kurtosis of the latent effect

nodes.summary: The latent causal variable model of O'Connor and Price (2018, Equation 3) on a probability space: `α_k = q_k π + γ_k` with `π` independent of `(γ₁, γ₂)`, the law of `(γ₁, γ₂)` invariant under each sign flip, `π` of mean zero and unit variance, and both `α_k` of unit second moment. Fourth moments are assumed finite.
nodes.title: Latent causal variable model

nodes.summary: `-1 ≤ gcp` when `q₂² ≤ 1` (for nonzero `q₁, q₂` with `ρ_g² < 1`).
nodes.title: Genetic causality proportion is at least −1
Excess kurtosis of the latent effect is at least −2

nodes.summary: `E(π⁴) ≥ (E π²)² = 1`, so the excess kurtosis is at least `-2`.
nodes.title: Fourth moment of the latent effect is at least one

nodes.summary: Unit variance of `α₁` forces `q₁² ≤ 1` (the non-mediated part has variance `1 - q₁²`).
nodes.title: Mediated coefficient of the first trait is at most one in size

nodes.summary: Unit variance of `α₂` forces `q₂² ≤ 1`.
nodes.title: Mediated coefficient of the second trait is at most one in size

nodes.summary: The genetic causality proportion solves the paper's Equation 1: `q₂² / q₁² = (ρ_g²) ^ gcp` with `ρ_g = q₁ q₂`, for nonzero `q₁, q₂` with `ρ_g² < 1`.
nodes.title: Genetic causality proportion solves the defining equation
